notes: Independent Plant Disease reports describe the same core Cercospora cf. flagellaris symptom progression on hemp: onset on older lower-canopy leaves as small yellow/yellow-green flecks or specks, followed by round necrotic lesions with pale centers and brown/dark borders. Lesion size and color details differ by report and are not collapsed into the canonical proposition.
canonical_proposition: Cercospora cf. flagellaris leaf spot on hemp can begin on older lower-canopy leaves as small yellow to yellow-green flecks or specks and progress to round necrotic lesions with pale centers and darker brown borders.

notes: Both independent Plant Disease reports include whole-plant inoculation evidence reproducing field-like lesions and recovery/reisolation of the same Cercospora cf. flagellaris organism; the later report also records healthy controls and a successful repeat. This supports the same core pathogenicity proposition without treating protocol details as identical.
canonical_proposition: Independent whole-plant inoculation studies support pathogenicity of Cercospora cf. flagellaris on hemp by reproducing compatible leaf-spot symptoms and recovering or reisolating the organism from inoculated plants.
